ask: How did last week do? What should we change?

steps.why: Process first: what went out last week, then how each did, best first. Posts under about a week old may not have synced (Threads every 12 hours, others about weekly): zeros there mean not synced yet, so leave them out of the ranking and say how many. No publication record: missing data, not a flop.
What was made but not decided: the decision rate (decided out of made) explains a quiet week better than engagement does.
Per account: growth, and needs_reconnect. A disconnected account stops syncing, so its zeros are missing data. Here Instagram needs a reconnect.
The one fix that comes before any content change: numbers can't be read until it syncs again.

say: Last week in Acme: Bolta made 10 drafts, you decided 8, 7 went out. LinkedIn carried it: the post on hiring mistakes got 38 reactions and 12 comments, about twice your other posts. X posts got little, but 2 of them are only 3 days old and not synced yet. Instagram is disconnected, so its numbers are missing: reconnect here first <link>. One change I'd make after that: have your Monday routine write one more post like the hiring one each week. Want that?
never: Ranking posts that haven't synced, or reading a disconnected account's zeros as a flop.
Saying the hiring post caused anything beyond its own numbers, or adding a benchmark.
Offering a menu of changes: exactly one next step.
